blocks.text: NMR spectroscopy nuclei ki magnetic properties (khoobiyon), yani nuclear spin, par based hai. Jin atoms ka mass number odd (taaq) ho, woh aam taur par NMR mein signal dete hain. Aise atoms ke nuclei, jaise hydrogen (¹H) aur carbon-13 (¹³C), aik tiny (nanhe) magnet ki tarah kaam karte hain. Jab magnetic field na ho to in tamam nuclei ki orientation (rukh) random (be-tarteeb) hoti hai aur sab ki energy barabar hoti hai. Jab inhein strong (taqatwar) magnetic field mein rakha jaye to yeh ya to field ke saath (with) ya field ke khilaf (against) align ho jate (rukh kar lete) hain. Is tarah do spin states banti hain: low energy state aur high energy state (Figure 30.1).

blocks.alt: Oopar ki taraf Energy ka axis. Baen taraf do ghoomte nuclei, aik ka teer oopar aur aik ka neeche, aik hi energy level par baithe hain: before field is applied. Phir level do mein bat jata hai: oopar wala 'against' (nucleus ka teer neeche) aur neeche wala 'with' (nucleus ka teer oopar); dono levels ke darmiyan double-headed (do-rukha) teer. Label: after field is applied.
blocks.caption: Figure 30.1: Magnetic field mein nuclei ki alignment (rukh) aur spin flipping (kitab ki Figure 30.1 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Field lagne se pehle sab nuclei ki energy aik hai, is liye dono aik hi line par hain. Field lagne ke baad jo nuclei field ke saath (with) hain woh neeche wale, low energy level par aur jo khilaf (against) hain woh oopar wale, high energy level par chale jate hain. Radio wave in do levels ke farq jitni energy de to nucleus flip ho (palat) jata hai (spin flipping).

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Jin atoms ka atomic number aur mass number dono even (juft) hon, un ke nuclei mein magnetic fields aik doosre ko cancel (khatam) kar dete hain, is liye un ka koi net (kul) magnetic field nahi hota, jaise ¹²C.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke aise nuclei mein protons aur neutrons ka number barabar hota hai. Yeh hamesha sach nahi: ¹⁸O mein 8 protons aur 10 neutrons hain. Asal baat yeh hai ke protons ka number bhi even hai aur neutrons ka bhi, is liye protons apne spins ke pairs (jore) bana lete hain aur neutrons apne, aur net magnetic field khatam ho jata hai.

Jab nuclei par radio waves dali jati hain to low energy state wale nuclei energy absorb (jazb) kar ke high energy state mein chale jate hain; isay spin flipping (spin ka palatna) kehte hain. Jab yeh wapas apni original (asal) state mein aate hain to energy emit karte (chhorte) hain. Yeh energy detect kar ke NMR spectrum (plural: spectra) bana di jati hai. Kisi nucleus ko flip karne ke liye kitni energy chahiye, yeh compound mein us ki position (jagah) aur us ke gird atoms par depend karta hai; in sab ko mila kar molecular environment kehte hain. Is liye NMR aik hi molecule mein different environments wale hydrogen atoms ko alag alag pehchan sakta hai. Misal: methanol (CH₃OH) mein teen hydrogen atoms carbon se jure hain aur aik hydrogen oxygen se. Methyl (-CH₃) hydrogens aur hydroxyl (O-H) hydrogen ka environment alag hai, is liye flip hone ke liye yeh alag alag amount ki energy (radio waves ki alag frequency) absorb karte hain.
Different environments wale nuclei ko aik hi frequency ki radio waves se bhi flip kiya ja sakta hai, agar magnetic field ki strength (taqat) badli jaye.

blocks.alt: Methanol ka displayed formula (khula formula): carbon teen hydrogen atoms (blue) aur aik oxygen se jura hai, aur oxygen aik hydrogen (red) se. Label: methanol.
blocks.caption: Methanol (30.1 ke aakhir mein chhape structure ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen blue hydrogens carbon se jure hain aur sab ka environment aik hai; red hydrogen oxygen se jura hai. Is liye methanol mein do qism ke protons hain aur NMR mein do signals aate hain.

blocks.prompt: NMR methanol ke CH₃ hydrogens ko OH hydrogen se alag kyun pehchan leta hai?
blocks.explanation: Dono ka environment alag hai (aik C se jura, aik O se), is liye inhein flip karne ke liye alag energy (frequency) chahiye.

items: ¹H aur ¹³C nuclei tiny magnets hain; magnetic field mein do spin states banti hain.
Radio waves spin palatti hain (spin flipping); zaroori energy molecular environment par depend karti hai.
Is liye alag alag environments ke hydrogen atoms alag signals dete hain.
